capability: Legacy Hupsel file run to typed application mapping

reference_authority.reused_immutable_evidence: F-PE19 full B1.11 replay and SWAP-011 provenance

local_reconstruction.method: Exact official B0 bytes replayed through the already admitted deterministic B1.5p1, B1.6, B1.7, B1.8, B1.9 and B1.10 transforms, followed by the exact SHA-verified B1.10-to-B1.11 SWAP-011 transform. No implementation was reconstructed from prose.
local_reconstruction.historical_library_patch_note: The Library text representation normalized line endings. Original patch bytes were restored deterministically from unified-diff line classes and accepted only after exact SHA-256 equality to the already governed 1d3daab... identity.

build.standalone_preprocessing: Only non-active Intel !DEC$ conditional branches were resolved for standalone Linux compilation; no equation, parameter, physics, solver, timestep or tolerance was modified.

official_hupsel_authority.correction_to_stale_prior_notes: The exact official Hupsel input has SWDRA=1 and swap.dra has NRLEVS=2. Any earlier note claiming SWDRA=2 or NRLEVS=5 is superseded by this byte-authoritative observation.

uninstrumented_b1_11_hupsel.gnu_portability_adjustment: Disposable run copy used SWCSV=0 instead of SWCSV=1 solely for the already-qualified GNU CSV-output portability issue; the official input authority remains the unmodified swap.swp hash above.
uninstrumented_b1_11_hupsel.normalization: remove only the generated '* Generated at:' timestamp line

observation_selection: For each frozen date, select the first accepted soil-water interval whose interval start is at or after 12:00 local model time.
next_permitted_action: Instrument only a disposable exact-B1.11 source copy at the post-SoilWater(3), pre-TimeControl(3) accepted-interval boundary. Observe the preregistered six intervals, all required application selectors/fluxes/root/drainage/bottom/irrigation fields, and then require the normalized result.bal/result.blc hashes to remain exactly equal to this checkpoint before using the trace as authority.
fail_closed_conditions: B1.11 source manifest or protected target identity changes
instrumentation executes inside solver or retry calculations
instrumented normalized result.bal or result.blc differs from the uninstrumented baseline
a frozen interval cannot be selected unambiguously
an uncovered SWINTER=3 or SWCF=2 route is inferred rather than reported as UNCOVERED_ROUTE
